# Alex Rodrigues Gomes

> Creative director and media producer in Vista, California. Ten years of branding, photography, video production and UX, plus a B.A. in Theology (Rochester University, 2026). Makes cinematic Bible-story short films for the YouTube channel Living Devotional.

## About

- [Portfolio](https://portfolio.agcreationmkt.cloud/): work, background and contact for Alex Rodrigues Gomes.
- [How the films are made](https://portfolio.agcreationmkt.cloud/blog/how-i-make-these/): full disclosure of the AI-assisted production pipeline — imagery is AI-generated; script, shot design, character continuity, curation, edit and cost are entirely human.

## Living Devotional blog

Written companions to the [Living Devotional](https://www.youtube.com/@living-devotional) YouTube channel. Each post retells one Bible narrative in full and applies it to a specific modern experience.

- [Why God Makes You Wait While Everyone Else Moves On](https://portfolio.agcreationmkt.cloud/blog/why-god-makes-you-wait/): A retelling of Joseph in Genesis 37-41 focused on Genesis 40:23 — the cupbearer forgetting him — and what a long, silent waiting season is actually forming in a person.
